$comment: Hand-written from SPEC SB-2 (with A5 and A18), SB-5, SB-6, SM-3, and section 7. This file must never be generated by code. Window 3 years back and 1 year ahead (A33), budget 40,000 characters unless a case says otherwise; an event of the year after the story year sits under plannedAhead. Ages are year-only arithmetic (TL-3) except Iris, who has a full birth date, asked about a year. 'supplement' means fixtures/brief/supplement.json is applied to the fixture first. Groups list entry IDs in the order the brief shows them; empty groups are omitted here and must be empty. A39 (SM-3): step 1 also takes each present character's moments up to the story year, a character carries their latest Voice moment at or before the year as a ref, and knowledge, beats, themes, custom entries, and events at the strand's places went with the cut model.

partTwo.$comment: SM-3, SB-5: a whole-part session (PT2, story year 2040 from CH5). Each strand takes the moments of its characters present up to its own year; the union over the part's strands. B1 (Peter, 2029) and B3 (Ruth, 2041) are left out: neither is present in a strand of the part whose year reaches theirs. B6 (Lan, 2060) comes in through CH7, set in 2060.
